_meta.indication: YUPELRI (revefenacin) inhalation solution is indicated for the maintenance treatment of patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group study; REV 88 mcg and REV 175 mcg once-daily via general use nebulizer vs placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults ≥ 40 years with moderate-to-very severe COPD (GOLD 2011), current or ex-smokers with ≥ 10 pack-year history, post-bronchodilator FEV1 < 80% predicted and > 0.7 L, FEV1/FVC < 0.70.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in trough FEV1 at Week 12 (defined as mean of FEV1 values at 23.25 and 23.75 hours after the day 84 dose).
pivotal_trials.n: Study 126: placebo N=209, REV 88 mcg N=212, REV 175 mcg N=198 (619 enrolled).
pivotal_trials.result: Study 126: LS mean difference from placebo in change from baseline trough FEV1 was 146.3 mL for REV 175 mcg (95% CI 103.7, 188.8) and 79.2 mL for REV 88 mcg (95% CI 37.3, 121.1); adjusted p-value vs placebo was 0.0003 for REV 88 mcg and < 0.0001 for REV 175 mcg.

pivotal_trials.design: Replicate 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel group study with identical protocol to Study 126; REV 88 mcg and REV 175 mcg once-daily vs placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults ≥ 40 years with moderate-to-very severe COPD (GOLD 2011), current or ex-smokers with ≥ 10 pack-year history, post-bronchodilator FEV1 < 80% predicted and > 0.7 L, FEV1/FVC < 0.70.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in trough FEV1 at Week 12 (defined as mean of FEV1 values at 23.25 and 23.75 hours after the day 84 dose).
pivotal_trials.n: Study 127: placebo N=208, REV 88 mcg N=205, REV 175 mcg N=197 (611 enrolled).
pivotal_trials.result: Study 127: LS mean difference from placebo in change from baseline trough FEV1 was 147.0 mL for REV 175 mcg (95% CI 97.0, 197.1) and 160.5 mL for REV 88 mcg (95% CI 110.5, 210.5); adjusted p-value vs placebo < 0.0001 for both doses.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥ 2% and more common than placebo) were cough (4% vs 4% placebo), nasopharyngitis (4% vs 2%), upper respiratory tract infection (3% vs 2%), headache (4% vs 3%), and back pain (2% vs 1%).
target_moa: Revefenacin is a long-acting muscarinic antagonist (anticholinergic) with similar affinity to muscarinic receptor subtypes M1 to M5; in the airways it inhibits the M3 receptor at smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held; the application was not referred because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues.

basis.text: The application received Standard (not Priority) review.

summary.text: Revefenacin was submitted as a 505(b)(1) NME NDA by Theravance Biopharma and received Standard review with a November 10, 2018 PDUFA goal date; it was approved on the first cycle without referral to an advisory committee, based on two replicate Phase 3 12-week trials (Studies 126 and 127).
